page.overview:
Who is Child Goron?

In , reside on , where they are almost as numerous as their adult counterparts. exhibit the same tribal pride and manners of speaking as grown-up , but they have a predilection toward playing as well as a variety of personality traits. One seems annoyed by his father's obsession with with , and another one rewards with a for defeating a group of which have appeared on a nearby hill. Some readily welcome to their homeland, with several even willing to call the young hero "Brother" before he has officially joined the tribe, while others are more hesitant to trust him, including the 's son, . also appear on , where they help to set up and manage the .

While the average maturation period of a is unknown, one particular is shown to grow into a full-sized by the time has completed the .

Several appear in . One is the 's grandson, who is known simply as the . After completes the , the asks to take him to , as he would like to experience life in the "big city" and hopefully meet a in-person.

A different manages the just west of . Another is held captive at the , while his friend waits outside the Hideout's entrance to request help from ; these two appear to perpetually swap places whenever the captive one is rescued.
